notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additonal Zombie.
description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {B}.
Gravecrawler dies, triggering Soldevi Adnate, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
